remarks: Amazing Space Awaits in Desirable & pet friendly Greenfield! Come see this Private, end-unit townhome and enjoy easy living - bright and warm with an abundance of windows and sunshine! Contemporary kitchen features stunning granite countertops, rich cabinetry, stainless appliances and opens to the large living/dining area. You'll also reap the economic benefits of green-built certification construction, natural gas heat, tankless hot water, central air AND NO ADDITIONAL FEES. Greenfield is a pet-friendly community with the following restrictions: 2 dogs  35lbs, 1 dog  60lbs., 2 cats or 1 small dog and 1 cat are allowed. Aggressive breeds are not permitted. Greenfield is a no smoking community.  Interested applicants please submit Greenfield Application found in supplements and credit check through applyconnect ONLY.
